title: OpenAI Introduces GPT-6.1 Terra AI Model With Cost Efficiency, Software Engineering Capabilities Improvements Over GPT-5.6 Terra
summary: OpenAI has announced GPT-6.1 Terra, a new AI model offering improved communication, visual reasoning, and computer-use capabilities alongside 50 percent lower standard API pricing than its predecessor, GPT-5.6 Terra. The model is accessible to developers via the OpenAI API and features enhanced software engineering performance and stronger resistance to malicious prompts.

title: Nanbeige ships an open 33B coder with 512K context
summary: The Nanbeige team released Nanbeige4.3-33B under the Apache 2.0 license, featuring a 512K context window and agentic coding capabilities. The dense 33B parameter model allows builders to run, modify, and fine-tune it locally on their own hardware.

title: Tencent Hy-Nomas: an open interactive video world model
summary: Tencent Hy has released Hy-Nomas, an open-weight interactive video world model under the Apache-2.0 license. The model allows users to steer video generation segment-by-segment using text instructions and camera trajectories, featuring a persistent KV cache for consistency and capable of running on a single consumer GPU.

title: DataKernelBench: Can LLMs Optimize Database Queries on GPUs?
summary: IBM Research introduces DataKernelBench, a benchmark translating SQL into validated PyTorch TorchPlan programs to evaluate LLMs on optimizing database-style operators in CUDA or Triton. The strongest full-query CUDA configuration achieved a 2.11x speedup over torch.compile, demonstrating that higher-performing implementations leverage kernel fusion and execution-strategy changes.

title: vLLM Delivers Day-0 Support for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash
summary: vLLM has introduced day-0 support for the MiniMax-M3.1-Flash model across NVIDIA Blackwell, Rubin, and AMD MI350-series GPUs. The update includes optimized kernels for NVFP4 KV caches and MoE weights, indexer decode context parallelism, and FlashInfer backend integration to boost inference efficiency for agentic workloads.

title: Mistral releases Large 4, a 1.05T-parameter open-weight model
summary: Mistral has released Mistral Large 4, an open-weight multimodal mixture-of-experts model featuring 1.05 trillion total parameters, 52 billion active parameters, a 1.6-billion-parameter vision encoder, and a 1-million-token context window. The model is currently available in public preview with competitive pricing for input and output tokens.

title: Announcing Humming: Fast, Flexible Kernels for Quantized Inference
summary: Ant Group and the vLLM community have open-sourced Humming, a high-performance kernel library for quantized inference that supports NVIDIA architectures from Turing onward as well as T-Head's Zhenwu 810E. The library decouples quantization descriptions from execution, providing a unified architecture across diverse integer and floating-point formats to significantly outperform existing implementations like vLLM Marlin and DeepGEMM.
